statement: This sketch creates an evolving, geological landscape of interwoven crystalline structures that pulse with deep, cyclical colors. As time passes, the crystals subtly shift and grow, forming an intricate tessellation across the canvas. A viewer's click introduces localized energy that accelerates growth in nearby structures, creating a ripple effect that temporarily disrupts the natural rhythm before the deep, timeless process resumes its slow, mesmerizing dance.
